summary: Anthropic announced a $65 billion Series H funding round at a $965 billion valuation, alongside new compute agreements with Amazon, Google/Broadcom, and SpaceX and strategic infrastructure partnerships with Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix.

mechanisms.reason: Anthropic disclosed new multi-gigawatt compute agreements to expand capacity for training and serving Claude.
mechanisms.quote: We signed agreements with Amazon for up to five gigawatts of new capacity, with Google and Broadcom for five gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity, and with SpaceX for access to GPU capacity in Colossus 1 and Colossus 2.

mechanisms.reason: The new compute deals are denominated explicitly in gigawatts of capacity, indicating large incremental datacentre power demand.
mechanisms.quote: We signed agreements with Amazon for up to five gigawatts of new capacity, with Google and Broadcom for five gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity

mechanisms.reason: Anthropic cites rapidly growing enterprise and consumer adoption and revenue run-rate as the driver for expanding compute.
mechanisms.quote: Since our Series G in February, adoption has continued to grow across global enterprise customers, and our run-rate revenue crossed $47 billion earlier this month.

mechanisms.reason: New strategic partnerships with memory suppliers suggest expectations of higher memory demand tied to compute scale-up, though the document does not detail per-accelerator memory content.
mechanisms.quote: Joining them are strategic infrastructure partners — Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix — whose technologies play a critical role in the world's supply of memory, storage, and logic chips.

categories.reason: Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix are named as strategic partners supplying memory, storage and logic for Anthropic's compute scale-up.
categories.quote: strategic infrastructure partners — Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix — whose technologies play a critical role in the world's supply of memory, storage, and logic chips

categories.reason: Amazon, Google and Microsoft are deepened as cloud/compute partners, with Claude now on all three major cloud platforms and new capacity deals.
categories.quote: Claude is the first frontier model available on all three of the world's largest cloud platforms: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

categories.reason: A new agreement with Google and Broadcom for next-generation TPU capacity directly involves custom AI accelerator silicon.
categories.quote: with Google and Broadcom for five gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity

categories.reason: Anthropic secured GPU capacity access within SpaceX's Colossus compute clusters, a third-party hosted compute arrangement.
categories.quote: with SpaceX for access to GPU capacity in Colossus 1 and Colossus 2

notable_reason: A record-scale $65B funding round tied to disclosed multi-gigawatt compute commitments across Amazon, Google/Broadcom, and SpaceX, plus new memory/logic supplier partnerships, is directly material to infrastructure and semiconductor investors.
